Novated Lease Guide & Calculator

Open the Calculator → Check Your Employer →

Calculator models true net cost — not the inflated "tax saved" figure providers advertise.

Many people dismiss EV novated leases for the wrong reasons, based on outdated rules of thumb rather than current rules.

Many people sign up for novated leases for the wrong reasons, based on misleading sales pitches rather than a clear understanding of costs, risks, and trade‑offs.

This site is written for both. The calculator is one of very few that models true net savings — not the misleading "tax saved" figure most providers advertise. The accompanying articles cover the pros and cons in depth, written by someone with no affiliation with any leasing company and no financial interest in your decision.

🆕 Updated May 2026: The calculator and articles fully reflect the new EV FBT wind-back rules announced in the May 2026 Budget — including the 25% FBT discount applying from April 2027 for eligible EVs above $75,000. Read the full explainer →
